common_mistakes.description: {"bad_action": "Spending actions engaging with and picking up the corpse rather than treating navigation to the unseen goal as the priority.", "trigger_condition": "Distracting entities (a jackal, its corpse) appear in the room during navigation."}
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Check the observed feedback and avoid repeating this demonstrated failure.

common_mistakes.description: {"bad_action": "Wandering further from the remembered staircase position (e.g., Northeast, East, North along the room edge) without re-pathing directly back toward it.", "trigger_condition": "The > tile's location has already been observed, but the agent has drifted away from it into other parts of the room."}
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Check the observed feedback and avoid repeating this demonstrated failure.

common_mistakes.description: {"bad_action": "Repeating the same blocked direction on subsequent turns (e.g., South, then South again), wasting turns that give the monster free attacks and drain HP", "trigger_condition": "A movement attempt returns 'It's solid stone' (blocked by a wall), especially while a monster is adjacent and attacking each turn"}
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Check the observed feedback and avoid repeating this demonstrated failure.

common_mistakes.description: {"bad_action": "Continuing unproductive wandering and wall-bumping until the environment terminates (as at step 30 with won=false), so the episode ends before the downstairs is ever located.", "trigger_condition": "Steps are being consumed with no progress (no '>' observed, reward 0) and the episode has a finite step budget."}
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Check the observed feedback and avoid repeating this demonstrated failure.

common_mistakes.description: {"bad_action": "Stepping directly into positions adjacent to grid bugs and absorbing repeated zaps (steps 3-5) when the bugs are not blocking the only route. Instead, prefer routing around hazards and engage them only when they physically obstruct the path to the goal.", "trigger_condition": "Grid bugs are adjacent to the agent's path and moving next to them triggers 'You get zapped!' messages."}
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Check the observed feedback and avoid repeating this demonstrated failure.
